title: HB0192 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-25; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2664142)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2023-01-25 (as introduced). Text has no marks: SECTION 1 replaces (a)(2) and, as printed, says the posted-property prohibition applies to persons authorized under 39-17-1307(g) or 39-17-1366 (this appears to remove the enhanced-permit exemption described in the state summary; the old (a)(2) text is not shown, so the reviewer should compare against current law). The summary says the bill exempts enhanced permit holders and removes the Class B misdemeanor penalty; SECTION 2 deletes subsection (c).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1359(a)(2)): (2) The prohibition in subdivision (a)(1)(A) shall apply to any person who is authorized to carry a firearm by authority of § 39-17-1307(g) or § 39-17-1366.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1359(c)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359, is amended by deleting subsection (c) in its entirety.
